Prashant Kishor complains against Patna SSP to Election Commission

Political strategist Prashant Kishor approached the Chief Electoral Officer in Patna to file a complaint against Patna SSP Kartikeya Sharma. Kishor alleged that leaders of his 'Jan Suraj' campaign were being arrested without valid reasons. He demanded action against the SSP. The complaint was lodged before the results of the Bankipore by-election were announced.
